app_tagline: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [ᱥᱟᱱᱛᱟᱲᱤ] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [sat] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [sat] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [sat] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [sat] Type or speak your question for the helper...
